import java.util.Scanner;

public class TreeCount {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String[] line = scanner.nextLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(line[0]);
        int h = Integer.parseInt(line[1]);

        int[][] treeCounts = new int[36][36];
        for (int i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 36; j++) {
                treeCounts[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        treeCounts[0][0] = 1;

        for (int total = 1; total < 36; total++) {
            for (int minh = 0; minh <= total; minh++) {
                for (int root_idx = 1; root_idx <= total; root_idx++) {
                    int left_part = root_idx - 1;
                    int right_part = total - root_idx;
                    int val1 = treeCounts[left_part][0] * treeCounts[right_part][0];
                    int val2 = (treeCounts[left_part][0] - treeCounts[left_part][Math.max(minh - 1, 0)]) *
                               (treeCounts[right_part][0] - treeCounts[right_part][Math.max(minh - 1, 0)]);
                    treeCounts[total][minh] += val1 - val2;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(treeCounts[n][h]);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
